note: Contracts on the two named cannibal leaders made in cannibals_data.json (loads after it). They live in the cannibal village, not a roaming camp, so the Meitou helper pays no distance bonus for them and every giver can offer the job.

offer: There was a kitchen priest at the Fist who read to the novices while they ate. Alder Quill. He went north and found a worse table. Okran wants him ended.
Alder Quill wore the sun once. Now he cooks for the cannibals and quotes scripture while he does it. The Nation will pay to stop his mouth.
A priest of Okran gone over to the eaters. Quill. They say he lives among them, polite as a deacon. End him.
accept: Where do the cannibals keep him?
accepted: In the cannibal village, past the plains. He will offer you soup. Do not take it.
North, among the eaters. He is soft-spoken. Do not let that fool you.
decline: That is the Nation's shame, not mine.
report: Quill is dead? Okran's light finds even the kitchens. Here is your reward.
The kitchen priest is silenced. The Nation is grateful. Take this.
Dead among the eaters. Fitting. Your payment.

offer: The cannibals have a woman who salts people like hams. Mother Brine. Her cure-house is in their village. The Cities want the smoke put out.
Mother Brine keeps the eaters fed through the winters. Kill her and the winter does the rest of the work for us.
There is a cure-house in the cannibal village with fifty names on its beams. The woman who carved them is Mother Brine. End her.
accepted: In the cannibal village, in the smoke. Follow the smell.
She is old and never alone. Bring people you trust.
decline: I have no stomach for it.
report: Brine is dead? Then let them have a hungry winter. Here is the purse.
The cure-house is cold. Good. Take your cats.
Salted in her own smoke, I hope. Your reward.
